wedge: paste 2-3 received moving quotes + normalize included/excluded ladder truck at both ends, elevator reservation, AC/appliance work, disposal/cleaning, date premium, distance and move type => compare true all-in totals and flag missing-cost risk before choosing; no phone number and no mover lead form
last_material_result: One bounded distribution/wedge validation materially narrowed the candidate. Generic expected-range estimation is crowded: CalKit, MunGori, ThorKit, BigyoCalc and CalcTools already publish free moving-cost calculators, and ThorKit explicitly presents a negotiation range for judging whether a quote is reasonable. A newer independent tool, 이사견적체크, goes further by publishing expected ranges plus a checklist that tells users to verify whether ladder trucks at both origin/destination, AC relocation, disposal/cleaning and date premiums are included. Therefore wedges (1) generic expected-range estimator and (2) single-quote 'is this expensive?' checker are effectively KILLed as insufficiently differentiated. The surviving wedge is (3) actual multi-quote normalization: consumers already have 2-3 quotes but cannot compare totals apples-to-apples because included scopes differ. Lead-gen marketplaces focus on collecting move details and returning partner quotes; current independent calculators focus on generating a reference estimate. In this validation set, no strong incumbent was found whose primary interaction is pasting multiple already-received quotes and normalizing hidden extras into comparable all-in totals. Search acquisition is still risky because broad moving queries are dominated by calculators, guides and lead-gen marketplaces, so this remains ASSESS rather than BUILD gate.
economics: Validation spend KRW0. If the narrowed wedge survives, static v1 remains possible at KRW0 with client-side inputs only: 2-3 quote columns, inclusion toggles, editable add-on allowances and normalized all-in comparison. No backend/login/paid API is required. Monetary stakes are high, but organic acquisition is unproven and broad SEO competition is strong. Maintenance can be lower than a market-price estimator because the product can avoid claiming exact base prices and instead normalize user-entered quote scopes; optional default add-on allowances would need periodic review.
next_checkpoint: Run one bounded intent/distribution validation focused only on the surviving multi-quote normalization wedge: search for Korean evidence that consumers struggle with 견적서 포함내역/추가금/업체별 견적 차이 and inspect whether any incumbent lets users compare already-received quotes line-by-line without submitting contact details. Test query/page angles around '이사 견적서 비교', '포장이사 견적서 추가금', '이사 견적 포함 항목', and '이사 견적 업체마다 다른 이유'. KILL if the pain is mostly solved by existing comparison apps/checklists or if there is no reachable informational search/distribution wedge; advance toward VALIDATE only if actual quote-scope confusion is repeatedly evidenced and the apples-to-apples normalizer remains absent.
recommendation: KEEP at ASSESS, but mutate from a moving-cost estimator into a received-quote normalizer. Do not build generic price estimation, do not collect phone numbers, and do not become a mover marketplace. One more bounded pain/distribution check is required before considering full-static-v1 Founder Gate.
